name: sut-lost-and-found-workspace
description: SUT Lost & Found System (Integrated Next.js Web/API + React Native Mobile App for DGT01 1130 & DGT01 1230)

scripts.dev: concurrently -i -n "SERVER-API,EXPO-APP,EMULATORS" -c "cyan,green,yellow" "npm run web" "npm run mobile" "node scripts/open_all_emulators.js"
scripts.start: concurrently -i -n "SERVER-API,EXPO-APP,EMULATORS" -c "cyan,green,yellow" "npm run web" "npm run mobile" "node scripts/open_all_emulators.js"
scripts.dev:tunnel: concurrently -i -n "SERVER-API,EXPO-APP" -c "cyan,green" "npm run web" "cd lost-and-found && npx expo start --tunnel"
scripts.dev:android: concurrently -n "SERVER-API,EXPO-APP,EMULATORS" -c "cyan,green,yellow" "npm run web" "npm run mobile" "node scripts/open_all_emulators.js"
scripts.mobile: node scripts/silence_expo_warnings.js && cd lost-and-found && npx expo start --localhost
scripts.android: node scripts/silence_expo_warnings.js && cd lost-and-found && npx expo start --android

author: SUT DGT01 Group 7
